name: Zensar Experience (LinkedIn design language)
description: Design language observed on Zensar Technologies' LinkedIn posts (2026): full-bleed deep-indigo or fluid blue-violet-to-coral backgrounds, white wordmark top-right, 'An RPG Company' in the footer, a light-weight lead line followed by a bold key line, pastel section label bars, and the circle/square/triangle motif as corner clusters (sage quarter-circle top-left; mustard quarter-circle, teal triangle and navy square bottom-right).
method: Every colour below was sampled (7x7 median) from the published post images; nothing is invented. The navy overlay matches the FY25 annual-report print indigo (#211B5A), which cross-checks the sampling.

li_indigo.where: Monthly Digest cover - indigo photo overlay

li_navy.where: Monthly Digest cover - navy square module

li_sage.where: Monthly Digest cover - quarter circle, top-left

li_mustard.where: Monthly Digest cover - quarter circle, bottom-right

li_highlight.where: Manhattan Active WM card - text highlight box

li_grad_blue.where: New Year 2026 post - fluid gradient, violet-blue

li_grad_deep.where: New Year 2026 post - fluid gradient, deep plum

li_grad_coral.where: New Year 2026 post - fluid gradient, coral

rules.headline: light lead line + bold key line
rules.section_label: pastel bar with the section name
rules.cover: fluid gradient (blue-violet -> plum -> coral) or deep indigo, white type
rules.quote: lavender field, large lavender quotation marks, dark text
